responsibility: This Python housekeeping script recursively traverses GNU Modula-2 source trees and normalizes copyright date lists in file headers for several source formats. For .in, .py, .c, .h, .def, and .mod files it detects the leading copyright notice, rewrites wrapped year sequences to a consistent line length while removing duplicate years, and replaces the original file in place; if no copyright notice is found in a sufficiently large file, it emits a warning diagnostic instead. Its role is narrower than full boilerplate regeneration: it focuses specifically on tidying date formatting within existing headers.
